title: You may not get the seasonal box you expect
text: The low rating is not because the box wasn’t amazing- the box is in fact amazing. The low rating is because I thought I was subscribing for the next box which should have been winter and what I got was an odd combination of the Fall 2018 box and the summer 2019 box. The stuff in the box was awesome, the value was awesome, it just wasn’t what I was expecting.
label: negative
